items.difficulty_reason: Verifies the stack axioms for the lifting category C over W_spaces,etale: fibres are groupoids by the deform-property lemma, pullbacks are constructed explicitly with strong cartesianness, and the descent (effectiveness) condition assembles the local isomorphisms into a global object through the equivalence-relation/quotient/effectiveness argument in-span; the leftover descent-of-morphisms step is left to the reader and the transitivity omission is mechanism-named bookkeeping.
